notes: transfer request: ST_TRNS_MAST_REQUEST types EFFECT 7 / TRNS_TYPE 9, DATE_SERIAL per date, locked once a transfer is issued; action TO_ISSUE = issue transfer from the request (legacy REQ_TRNS_* of ST_TRANSFER_FROM, APP_CONV); wave 3: delete refused once transferred (DB hooks APP_RULES_ST_REQ_BD / _REQDET_BD), duplicate DOC_NO question, store balance display (APP_ACT_ST)

ST_TRNS_DET_REQUEST.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_TRNS_DET_REQUEST.STORE_BALANCE.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_USER_CODE')), 0) = 0 or (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_balance), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1) then round((select nvl(sum(get_balance_confg(h.store_code, c.group_code, c.item_code, c.item_confg_id, h.trns_date)), 0) from st_trns_mast_request h, st_item_confg c where h.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and h.trns_serial = t.trns_serial and c.group_code = t.group_code and c.item_code = t.item_code) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) end

ST_TRNS_MAST_REQUEST.TRNSFER_TO_STORE.lov: select s.store_code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or s.store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by s.store_code

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE in (select t.trns_type_code from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 7 and t.trns_type = 9) and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or TRNS_TYPE_CODE in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

validations.name: legacy header rules (type of the screen, CHECK_DATE, stores, transfer issued)

actions.name: TO_ISSUE
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد عمل حركة تحويل (صادر) بأصناف طلب التحويل؟ يتم اختيار الشحنات حسب تاريخ الصلاحية والرصيد.
actions.confirm_e: Issue a transfer with the items of this request? The lots are taken by expiry date and stock.

params.name: TRNS_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', t.desc_e, t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 5 and t.trns_type = 9 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER and tp.flag = 1)) order by t.trns_type_code
